title: Econ Data Library: A Citable Catalog of Economic & Financial Time Series
description:
The Econ Data Library (econdatalibrary.com) is a free, non-commercial academic data library giving students and researchers one clean, well-documented, citable place to find economic and financial statistics. Measured on the complete data store (census 2026-07-02): ~7.73 billion individual time series and ~79.8 billion observations, surfaced through a curated catalog of 1,234,073 searchable entries from 182 served sources — international organizations (World Bank, IMF, UN, OECD, Eurostat, ECB, BIS, ILO, FAO), national statistical offices and central banks, and research datasets hosted with written permission.

Every series ships with producer-first attribution: the CSV header and per-series metadata carry the original producer, its license, a ready-made citation, and a link back to the authoritative source. Access is via the website, a free REST API, an MCP server for AI assistants, and Python/R clients. This record is the citable reference for the library; the compilation and documentation are CC BY 4.0, while each underlying series remains governed by its original producer's terms (surfaced per-series; non-redistributable sources are not served).

Part of the ElkassabgiData family of research libraries (elkassabgidata.com).
